card.name: Small linking words before clinical nouns
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, on, of, is, their, make) that sit right after a verb or phrase and just before a condition, symptom or diagnosis term. Seen in medical text on causes, severity and risk.

modes.label: Depending on
modes.description: The word 'on' after 'Depending' ahead of 'the severity of the symptoms'.

modes.label: Verb then article
modes.description: A word such as 'the' or 'is' after a verb like obscure or what, before a diagnosis or cause.
modes.example: since folic acid may obscure<< the>> diagnosis of pernicious anemia by

modes.label: Linking word before outcome
modes.description: A word like 'make' or 'of' that leads into a worsening or a risk.
modes.example: Iron deficiency can cause RLS or<< make>> it worse.

card.writes: It pushes toward odd function-like and foreign tokens and away from fault, diagnosis-like words, so the effect is unclear.
